message: A duty role in Oracle Fusion defines a set of privileges required to perform a specific business task or duty. Duty roles are assigned to job or abstract roles, not directly to users in standard RBAC architecture.

parameters.query: what is a duty role in oracle fusion?

toolResult.dataSource: Authoritative Oracle Fusion RBAC Architecture Documentation

data.description: Represents duties required to perform business functions.
